description: You even get fat, 34mm gold tube air forks and 203mm front/rear brakes with 4 piston hydraulic calipers for you on the Mullet Pro. Now with even better handling with a lower center of gravity through a beefy new suspension design with new linkage, and Boost Axle fork with fat, HyperTek-coated, 34mm fork tubes for more control and better handling on both smooth and rough terrain. You also get a lower standover height for easier maneuvering and a lighter feel. And at only 53 lbs, it's a bike you can handle. Cyberbike's V2 Chassis Lower Center-of Gravity for easier direction changes and a lighter feel Boost (big axle) fork New Wolf e-Spec Suspension 4 piston hydraul
